resources.title: EVERYTHING You NEED TO KNOW About the new POE2 Season
resources.creator: Zizaran
resources.noteEs: Zizaran condensa todo el patch 0.5 (Return of the Ancients) en 18 minutos: liga Runes of Aldur, dos ascendencias nuevas (Spiritwalker Huntress, Martial Artist Monk), Atlas redesign, Breach reworkeado, Genesis Tree de crafting. Anchor de mechanics-per-league para los players que arrancan PoE 2 cada nueva temporada.

Anchor for mechanics-per-league for players entering PoE 2 each new season.
